ios.desc:
You opened an editing app, saw twenty sliders, and closed it. You saved the
style everyone was posting, but the prompt was never in the comments.

Entory asks you for one thing: pick an art style.

It turns today's photo into a drawing and keeps it as a diary. Don't feel like
writing? Leave the title blank and the day is saved under its date.

HOW IT WORKS
· Pick a photo from today, choose an art style, and Entory draws it
· 53 art styles — watercolor, oil pastel, crayon, line art, collage, stickers, pets
· Redraw an entry up to twice
· Save a finished drawing to your camera roll, into an album called Entory
· Every entry becomes a photocard-size card (5.5 × 8.5 cm) you collect in albums
· Albums stay private until you invite someone into one
· AI does the drawing. The taste is yours

WHAT'S NOT HERE
No likes, no followers, no ads. A record with no numbers attached to it.

YOUR FIRST ONE
The first drawing is free, account or not.

SUBSCRIPTION
· Basic (monthly): 4 picture diaries a month, every art style, saving with no watermark
· Premium (monthly): 30 a month, every art style, and 3 custom styles a month that you describe in your own words
Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation. It renews automatically
unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the period ends; manage or cancel it
in your Apple ID settings.

Terms: https://entory.expo.app/legal/terms-en.html
Privacy: https://entory.expo.app/legal/privacy-en.html
Support: https://entory.expo.app/legal/support-en.html

quotes.text:
Location: Seoul, South Korea

Remote: preferred

Email: eunhye@choicode.com

Website: https://choicode.com

LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/eunhye-choicode

Software engineer with 6+ years of startup experience building AI-powered products — production systems with real infrastructure, not API wrappers.

Recently shipped:

Entory (https://apps.apple.com/app/apple-store/id6804258564?pt=129347965 · https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.choicode.entory): an AI photo-diary app I built alone and launched on both iOS and Android. It uses React Native (Expo) and Supabase (Postgres, RLS, Edge Functions) to proxy Google Vertex AI image generation. It also has a catalog of 50+ style prompts, subscriptions through RevenueCat and OTA updates through EAS.

- An AI media intelligence platform for filmmakers (https://youtu.be/manjyiUsfU8) — zero to production in 4 months as the sole engineer: agentic RAG across video, audio, image, and PDF archives, coordinating 5 AI APIs with automatic failure recovery, processing 8.5 hours of video in under 35 minutes.
- An automated CI/CD pipeline with macOS code signing & notarization (https://youtu.be/-DSCZX3uG_c)

Stack: TypeScript, React, React Native (Expo), Next.js, Go, PostgreSQL, Supabase, GCP, FFmpeg, GraphQL, Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform

Open to contract.
quotes.story_title: Ask HN: Who wants to be hired? (October 2026)
